# edgeos_port_forward (Resource)

One port forwarding rule (`port-forward rule <number>`), the rules shown on the Firewall/NAT > Port Forwarding page of the web UI.

EdgeOS only commits port forwarding rules when `wan-interface` and `lan-interface` are set, so manage those with `edgeos_port_forward_settings` and add `depends_on` pointing at it. Terraform then creates the settings first and destroys them last.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_port_forward_settings" "this" {
  wan_interface  = "eth0"
  lan_interfaces = ["switch0"]
  hairpin_nat    = true
  auto_firewall  = true
}

resource "edgeos_port_forward" "https" {
  number        = 1
  description   = "HTTPS to the reverse proxy"
  original_port = "443"
  protocol      = "tcp"

  forward_to = {
    address = "192.168.1.20"
    port    = "8443"
  }

  depends_on = [edgeos_port_forward_settings.this]
}

resource "edgeos_port_forward" "wireguard" {
  number        = 2
  description   = "WireGuard to the VPN box"
  original_port = "51820"
  protocol      = "udp"

  forward_to = {
    address = "192.168.1.30"
  }

  depends_on = [edgeos_port_forward_settings.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forward_to` (Attributes) The LAN host the traffic goes to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forward_to))
- `number` (Number) Rule number, 1 or higher. Changing it creates a new rule.
- `original_port` (String) Port on the WAN interface: a number, a range or a comma separated list, such as `443`, `8000-8010` or `80,443`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `tcp_udp`. Defaults to `tcp_udp`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule number.

<a id="nestedatt--forward_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forward_to`

Required:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address of the LAN host, such as `192.168.1.20`.

Optional:

- `port` (String) Port or range on the LAN host. Unset keeps `original_port`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_port_forward.example '1'
```
